content: {"reasoning":"Prior auth was required and missing at time of service (CO-197). This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer review. An appeal was already filed with no denial currently on the table to act on further. The deductible not being met means the patient share is the full allowed amount anyway, but the real issue is the auth denial is not overturnable through any available payer mechanism. Since the service was rendered without required auth, this becomes provider liability and cannot be billed to the patient or resubmitted; write-off is appropriate.","action":"write_off"}
